segmentation.text: Upon a highway designated and signposted for one-way traffic
shall be driven only in the direction designated.

elements.justification: st.one_way_roadway, 'roadway on which traffic is restricted to one direction', occupied by the subject (rel.occupies, 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region'), as the index maps 'Upon any highway on which traffic is restricted to one direction of movement' (NRS_484B_210_1). 'Traffic' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic, 'vehicles and other conveyances ... using any highway for purposes of travel', whose direction the designation restricts. 'Designated and signposted' is legal status: the one-way roadway's presence on the road is its evidence (observable_reading status).

'Vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle: 'every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway'; ru.aggregate is 'true when the user carries an included class'.

'Only in the direction designated' forbids motion against the one-way roadway's designated direction (st.lane_direction, 'direction of travel designated for a structure a vehicle travels in — ... a roadway, one-way roadway'): drv.motion.moving_against_carrier(subject, r) on the one-way roadway r of s1, with speed_tol = p.halt_speed_tolerance. 'Driven' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion (agency).

applicability: The subject, a vehicle, occupies a one-way roadway r (st.one_way_roadway).
obligation: At every such observation, for every one-way roadway r the subject occupies, the subject is not moving against r's designated direction: drv.motion.moving_against_carrier(subject, r) with speed_tol = p.halt_speed_tolerance does not hold.

narrowings.why: 'designated and signposted' is read through the one-way roadway's presence on the road, the evidence of its designation and posting
'driven' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion, whoever or whatever controls it

'only in the direction designated' is read as no motion component against the designated direction beyond the speed resolution; motion across the roadway (entering or leaving it) is not read as a breach

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: The subject occupies a st.one_way_roadway whose st.lane_direction is (1,0) and moves with kin.velocity (-8,0) m/s.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: The subject occupies the same one-way roadway and moves with kin.velocity (8,0) m/s.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The subject occupies a two-way st.roadway (not a one-way roadway) and moves in either direction.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: The subject occupies a one-way roadway whose st.lane_direction the source does not supply, moving at 8 m/s.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
